rules.title: Java ran out of heap memory
rules.advice: The JVM exhausted its heap. Open the instance's **Settings → Java** page and raise the maximum memory allocation. For modern modpacks, 6 GB is a reasonable starting point; very large packs may need 8–10 GB. If you only have 8 GB of RAM total, close other applications before launching.

rules.title: Metaspace exhausted
rules.advice: The class-metadata area is full. Add `-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m` (or higher) to the instance JVM args. This usually triggers in modpacks with hundreds of mods.

rules.title: Java version mismatch
patterns: has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime
rules.advice: Minecraft was compiled for a newer Java than is running. Open **Settings → Java** and pick a Java install that matches: 1.16.5 and older want Java 8, 1.17 wants Java 16, 1.18 → 1.20.4 want Java 17, 1.20.5+ wants Java 21.

rules.title: Mod targets a different Minecraft version
rules.advice: A mod is calling a method that doesn't exist in this Minecraft version. Usually means one of your mods was built for a different MC version. Check the line above the NoSuchMethodError — the class on the left of the missing method belongs to the misbehaving mod.
